jobs.title: Program Manager, Co-Innovation
jobs.description:
What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve

Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI , and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.

We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here.

Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.

How you’ll demonstrate Ownership

Ready to translate your consulting or delivery expertise into lasting product impact? As a Co-Innovation Program Manager at Cognite, you’ll work right at the seam between emerging AI product development and real-world customer operations.

Instead of just managing timelines, you will lead customer-partnered programs that put our latest capabilities into production. You’ll listen to how systems perform in the field, synthesize user insights, and partner directly with engineering and product leads to refine our platform.

The Impact you bring to Cognite

- Drive Co-Innovation: Own end-to-end delivery of customer-partnered programs that deploy emerging AI. Manage scope, timelines, resources, and risk to ensure successful outcomes.

- Harden the Product: Use customer deployments as a forcing function to pressure-test new capabilities. Surface edge cases, integration challenges, and gaps that only emerge in production environments.

- Feed Field Insights to Product: Systematically capture insights from the field and translate them into actionable product requirements. Partner with product managers and engineering leads to prioritize and sequence improvements.

- Orchestrate Delivery: Coordinate across Cognite engineers, data scientists, designers, and product teams. Remove roadblocks, manage dependencies, and keep workstreams aligned toward shared objectives.

- Ensure Production Readiness: Work with product teams and internal functions to define what "ready" means—ensuring new capabilities meet the bar for scalable sales and delivery before broader release.

- Facilitate Customer Collaboration: Lead workshops, working sessions, and technical discussions with customer teams. Extract signal from noise to identify the highest-leverage problems and validate solutions in real environments.

Required Qualifications

- You have 3+ years in tech consulting, TPM, or delivery: You know how to untangle complex client problems, build alignment, and keep high-stakes technical projects moving smoothly

- You love systems thinking: You easily connect the dots between raw software architecture, user feedback, and overarching business objectives.

- You're curious about AI & Industrial Tech: You don't need to be a deep data scientist on day one, but you are eager to learn how time-series data, LLMs, and enterprise platform architectures come together

- You communicate with clarity: You effortlessly translate dense technical challenges into clear, actionable paths forward for both clients and internal engineering teams.

Bonus points (nice to have, not required!)

- Exposure to AI/ML systems, LLM applications, or agentic workflows.

- Experience with industrial data (time series, sensor data, knowledge graphs) or platforms like Cognite Data Fusion (CDF).

- Background in fast-paced product environments with rapid iteration cycles.

Don't meet 100% of the preferred qualifications? We still encourage you to apply! We value adaptability, curiosity, and strong fundamentals.

A snapshot of our many perks and benefits as a Cogniter

* Join an organization of 60 different nationalities 🌐 with Diversity, Equality and Inclusion (DEI) in focus 🤝

* A highly modern and fun working environment with sublime culture across the organization, follow us on Instagram @ cognitedata  📷 to know more

* Flat structure with direct access to decision-makers

* Opportunity to work with and learn from some of the best people on some of the most ambitious projects found anywhere, across industries, with cutting edge technology

* Join our  HUB  🗣️ to be part of the conversation directly with Cogniters and our partners.

* Get access to private health services with Cognite Care.

* Hungry? We’ve got your back. A subsidized lunch at the canteen is delivered by the chefs at Fornebuporten (Aker Tech House)

* Our own  Cognite exclusive coffee bar  ☕ with the friendliest baristas is here to brew coffee for coffee lovers, tea for tea lovers, smoothie for smoothie lovers, and the baristas creative concoctions when the mood strikes.

* We take your mental- and physical health seriously by having a broad health offering and a free membership to our fully-staffed gym on-site.

* A pet lover? Get the chance to meet  Spot  at the Robot Garden!

Learn more about us

- Impact 2025

- Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot

- We’re globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi.

Equal Opportunity

Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.

jobs.description:

Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI , and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.

Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI, and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements. We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer with business acumen who is ready to tackle big challenges and advance their career. In this role, you'll join a team committed to creating cutting-edge business solutions that significantly impact critical business functions across Cognite. You will report to the Vice President of FP&A (Financial Planning & Analysis) and be tasked with building out the Cognite Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) for business data. This will include building the Semantic (logic/contextualization) layer for business data and leading the selection and implementation of a world class EDW AI solution. You'll collaborate with Finance, Sales, Marketing, P&O/HR, Legal, Engineering, etc. to deploy and optimize digital solutions that empower users to make better data-driven business decisions.

If you're passionate about leveraging technology to solve tough problems and are eager to impact the way Cognite operates, we want to hear from you. Let's build the future of Cognite business data, reporting and AI capabilities together.

Strategy & architecture

• Lead the design and implementation of a scalable Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) and efficient data engineering solutions using Azure, Fabric, Power BI, and Cognite Data Fusion®.

• Technology Selection: Evaluate and select data technologies, frameworks, and platforms to support future business scaling needs.

Build & integration

• Drive and manage integrations, extractions, data modeling, and analysis using data connectors and SQL, Python/Java, and REST APIs.

• Data Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain data pipelines (ETL/ELT) to move data from source systems into data warehouses or data lakes.

• Data Preparation: Clean, transform, and aggregate raw data into structured formats optimized for Power BI reporting and AI agents.

• Data Modeling: Create custom data models for data discovery, mapping, and cleansing. Define conceptual, logical, and physical data models to map out how different data entities relate to one another.

Operations & enablement

• Governance & Security: Establish standards for data quality, security, privacy, and compliance (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

• Collaborate with business stakeholders and engineering organizations to enable data-driven business decisions.

Job Requirements

Education & background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or a related field; relevant experience may compensate for formal education. A business degree (MBA) or demonstrated experience working in finance, sales, marketing, supply chain, or a similar business setting is strongly preferred.

Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience in internal or external customer-facing, data-intensive roles.

• Proven experience delivering production-grade data pipelines using Python, SQL, and REST APIs.

• Hands-on experience with Azure cloud services, including administration tasks such as subscription management and Key Vault; familiarity with GCP is a plus.

• Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse architecture, Notebooks (PySpark, Spark SQL, DAG workflows), and PowerShell scripting.

• Experience building and maintaining Power BI semantic models (star schema) and designing reports for business stakeholders.

• Proficiency with GitHub for version control, GitHub Actions for CI/CD, and Terraform for infrastructure and access management.

• Willingness to learn and ramp quickly on Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), including Python SDK, Flows/Dune, and GraphQL

Mindset & ways of working

• DevOps mindset with experience across CI/CD pipelines and deployment environments.

• Able to independently investigate and solve complex data problems with minimal direction.

• Comfortable working in cross-functional teams spanning both technical and business stakeholders.

• Demonstrates humility — willing to ask for help and actively shares knowledge with others.

A snapshot of our many perks and benefits as a Cogniter

* Competitive compensation

* 401(k) with employer matching

* Competitive health, dental, vision & disability coverages for employees and all dependents

* Unlimited PTO

* Paid Parental Leave Program

* Employee Referral Program

Learn more about us

Equal Opportunity

Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.

jobs.description:

Location: Field / Remote

Travel: Approximately 50% (Client sites & Texas / Arizona offices)

About Cognite

Cognite is a global industrial Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company enabling the full-scale digital transformation of heavy-asset industries. Our core software product, Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), powers companies with contextualized OT/IT data to develop and scale solutions that increase safety, sustainability, and operational efficiency while driving revenue.

Role Overview

As a Business Development Director within our Supply Chain Center of Excellence (CoE) , you will drive Cognite’s growth by winning new Supply Chain business within accounts headquartered in your territory. Operating as a subject matter expert, you will leverage deep domain insights to help customers transform their supply chain value chain using Cognite Applications and the Cognite Data Fusion Platform.

Key Responsibilities

- Territory & CoE Strategy: Develop and execute a targeted territory strategy to accelerate bookings growth and secure high-impact supply chain clients.

- Pipeline Generation: Actively prospect and leverage your personal network to generate pipeline, providing compelling "commercial insights" on optimizing the supply chain value chain.

- Complex Sales Execution: Lead extended territory teams (including pre-sales and technical experts) through complex enterprise sales cycles to exceed bookings targets.

- Value-Based Selling: Quantify ROI and present strong business cases to help enterprise executives justify software investments.

- Partner-savvy: work with partners to qualify and progress their pipeline, and drive joint engagements on qualified opportunities.

- Deal Negotiation: Support the Account / Engagement Leader in negotiating favorable pricing and commercial terms with C-level executives by demonstrating the long-term strategic value of Cognite’s solutions.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal Product Management and Marketing teams to feed real-market supply chain insights back into product strategy.

- Sales Hygiene & Forecasting: Support the Account Leaders and their First Line Managers in accurately forecasting monthly/quarterly bookings and maintaining up-to-date account records in Salesforce.com .

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities (KSAs) & Competencies

Core Competencies:

- Domain & Industry Expertise: Deep domain expertise in complex Supply Chain operations for Energy, Manufacturing or Power Utilities verticals. Understanding of Production operations and industry x.0 initiatives is also required.

- Strategic Value Selling: Ability to sell value and build quantified ROI frameworks for prospective buyers.

- Informal Leadership, Influence & Autonomy: High degree of self-motivation, time management, and ability to informally lead and effectively influence cross-functional deal teams.

- Executive Communication: Stellar presentation, written, and verbal communication skills tailored for C-suite engagement.

Knowledge & Technical Requirements:

- Enterprise Software/SaaS: Proven mastery of selling complex analytics or data platforms (e.g., AI, Big Data, Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, Machine Learning).

- Data Ecosystems: Familiarity with modern data architectures and tools, such as Big Data frameworks (Hadoop, Spark, Hive, BigQuery), Data Warehouses, and Machine Learning.

Role Qualifications

- Industry Experience: 10+ years of experience in the Manufacturing and broader industrial supply chain environment.

- Sales Track Record: 7+ years of direct or in-support sales experience, selling enterprise software/SaaS (BI, Big Data, Advanced Analytics, or AI/ML) to C-level executives, Management and operations.

- Proven Performance: Demonstrated history of consistently meeting or exceeding SaaS bookings goals in direct / partner / channel-based sales models

- Environment Experience: Prior experience operating in high-growth startup environments (Series A, B, or C stage).

- Education: Bachelor’s degree required.

A snapshot of our many perks and benefits as a Cogniter

- Competitive compensation

- 401(k) with employer matching

- Competitive health, dental, vision & disability coverages for employees and all dependents

- Unlimited PTO

- Paid Parental Leave Program

- Employee Referral Program

Learn more about us

- Impact 2025

- Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot

- We’re globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi.

Equal Opportunity

Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.

jobs.description:
What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve

Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI , and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.

We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here.

Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.

We are seeking a Senior Director, Compensation & Analytics to serve as the global owner of Cognite’s compensation philosophy & strategy, and operational governance. This is a high-impact, business-critical role at the intersection of strategy, financial rigor, and employee experience.

Our global footprint spans the US (Phoenix, Houston, and multistate presence), Norway, India (Bangalore), Japan, Western Europe, and the UAE — with continued growth through new entities and global hiring. How we reward, deploy, and develop our talent across these markets is central to our ambition.

We're hiring a Senior Director, Compensation & Analytics to own and execute the evolution of the compensation model to attract and retain against revised scopes and to be the analytics backbone behind a data-driven org with a People Dashboard and predictive attrition analytics . This role will also help lead how People & Organization itself scales using AI.

You'll build a small team (starting with one India-based direct report) designed for global coverage and analytical depth, and you'll be the person in Cognite when compensation strategy is being discussed.

You will evolve the compensation and benefits frameworks that reinforce performance culture, attract and retain world-class talent, and scale with Cognite’s growth. You are a hands-on subject matter expert and genuine team player — equally comfortable shaping long-term strategy and rolling up your sleeves to get things done. You will report directly to, and partner closely with, the VP, People Operations & Rewards, while serving as the subject matter expert to the CHRO and CFO alongside the broader People & Organization team.

How you’ll demonstrate Ownership

- Compensation Model Evolution: Lead the next evolution of Cognite's comp/equity retention framework, refining and strengthening it as its own dedicated workstream, ready to flex as integration milestones require. Refresh compensation benchmarking, Evolve our job architecture to align with post-acquisition scopes and enhance bonus variables to support a high performance culture. Own Cognite's job architecture as the structural foundation of the compensation model.

- Annual Compensation Cycles: Full ownership of the annual compensation cycle end to end — setting the timeline, allocating budget, guiding managers, supporting calibration, and executing everything in HiBob for both salary review and promotions. Safeguard the organization's comp decisions, working with P&O Business Partners and Advisors to make sure promotion and pay recommendations are consistent.

- Pay Transparency & Compliance Governance: Own Cognite's core pay transparency procedures — pay ranges, disclosure practices, and internal communication of how pay decisions are made — as a standing governance function. Build the audit trail and compliance documentation needed to demonstrate pay equity and transparency practices under applicable regulations across our operating geographies (including emerging pay transparency requirements in the EU, UK, and select US states). Partner with Legal & Compliance to keep pay transparency practices current as regulatory requirements evolve, particularly through integration with Schneider Electric/AVEVA.

- External & ESG Reporting: Provide compensation-related external reporting, including ESG disclosures tied to pay equity, gender/diversity pay gap reporting. Own the underlying data integrity and methodology behind any published pay-equity or compensation-related ESG metric.

- People Analytics & Predictive Infrastructure:  Build and own the People Dashboard: the single source of truth for workforce, compensation, and attrition metrics used by SLT. Build a predictive attrition analytics capability, piloted by location and division, feeding directly into our 8% regrettable-attrition target tracking. Own compensation and P&O reporting cadence — monthly, quarterly, and one-year retrospective reads — through the integration window. Review and advocate for internal or external support/talent required to improve P&O reporting muscle.

- M&A & Integration:  Serve as the compensation lead for job architecture mapping, pay philosophy harmonization, and equity conversion/replacement modeling with Schneider Electric/AVEVA if and when required. Support multi-jurisdiction equity and option-holder consent processes.Partner with  Finance on comp-related planning through and beyond close.

The Impact you bring to Cognite

- Minimum 10+ years in compensation and/or people analytics, including 3+ years leading a team, ideally in global technology, industrial software, or a company that has gone through AI-driven market repositioning

- Direct experience with M&A compensation integration — job architecture mapping, equity harmonization, or retention program design during a live transaction

- Demonstrated ability to build predictive or dashboard-based analytics capability from scratch (not just consume someone else's dashboard)

- Comfort growing a globally distributed team , including a direct report based in a different country and time zone

- Fluency in modern comp benchmarking, including how to position against AI-native / hypergrowth tech competitors, not just traditional industry peers

- Experience preparing materials for board compensation committees

- A genuine point of view on using AI tools (not just spreadsheets) to scale a comp/analytics function — you'll be expected to model this, not just support it

- Based in or willing to relocate to the Phoenix, AZ area; hybrid work model

Nice to have

- Experience with HiBob or comparable HRIS, and interest in AI-companion-driven HR workflows

- Prior experience managing comp/analytics talent in India or another APAC market

- Experience through a public-to-private or strategic acquisition integration end-to-end (announcement through Day-1 and beyond)

* Competitive health, dental, vision & disability coverages for employees and all dependents

* Unlimited PTO

* Paid Parental Leave Program
